description: Get TikTok music recommendations for exactly the uploaded images in a standard, non-catalog image ad (one card) or carousel. Verifies each image is carousel-usable. Read-only; select a returned music_id in the approval preview and use the same images in the ad. Music is for use on TikTok only.

advertiserId.description: Exact TikTok numeric ID as a string, never a rounded JavaScript number.

imageIds.description: Ordered list of 1-35 distinct uploaded image IDs owned by this advertiser. Use the exact same images in the approved carousel.

name: tiktok_get_carousel_music

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

title: tiktok get carousel music
